defects.business_impact: Search snippets fall back to page text; lower click-through.
defects.remediation_action: Write a 120-155 char meta description per key page.

defects.business_impact: Search engines may split ranking across URL variants.
defects.remediation_action: Add a self-referencing canonical link tag.

defects.business_impact: Link shares render as plain text; less social traffic.
defects.remediation_action: Add og:title, og:description, og:image tags.

defects.business_impact: Thin pages rarely rank or convert; intent unclear.
defects.remediation_action: Expand page with real service proof (photos, FAQs, reviews).

defects.business_impact: Mobile browsers may render a zoomed-out desktop layout.
defects.remediation_action: Add viewport meta (width=device-width,initial-scale=1).

defects.business_impact: No rich-result eligibility signals for local business info.
defects.remediation_action: Add LocalBusiness JSON-LD with name, phone, address.

defects.business_impact: Screen-reader users miss the image meaning; weaker image SEO.
defects.remediation_action: Add concise descriptive alt text to the image.

defects.observed: No lang attribute on the <html> element
defects.business_impact: Screen readers and browsers cannot determine the page language; accessibility and SEO suffer.
defects.remediation_action: Add a lang attribute to the <html> element, e.g. <html lang="en">
defects.evidence_summary: No lang attribute on the <html> element

defects.impact: Screen readers cannot describe images; accessibility and SEO suffer
defects.observed: 1 of 1 images have no alt text
defects.business_impact: Screen readers announce 'image' instead of context. Search engines cannot index image content. Both hurt accessibility and SEO.
defects.remediation_action: Add descriptive alt text to every informative image.
defects.evidence_summary: 1 of 1 images have no alt text

defects.impact: Layout shift risk; images without explicit dimensions cause CLS
defects.observed: 1 of 1 images lack width and height attributes
defects.business_impact: Images without explicit dimensions cause Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS), a Core Web Vital that hurts user experience and SEO.
defects.remediation_action: Add explicit width and height attributes to all images.
defects.evidence_summary: 1 of 1 images lack width and height attributes

defects.impact: No lazy-loading hint; below-the-fold images may load eagerly
defects.observed: 1 of 1 images lack a loading attribute
defects.business_impact: Images without loading="lazy" may delay page interactivity and increase initial payload.
defects.remediation_action: Add loading="lazy" to below-the-fold images.
defects.evidence_summary: 1 of 1 images lack a loading attribute

defects.impact: No Open Graph title for social sharing
defects.business_impact: When this page is shared on social platforms, the default page title is used instead of a custom share title.
defects.remediation_action: Add an og:title meta tag with a compelling share title.

defects.impact: No Open Graph description for social sharing
defects.business_impact: Social shares show generic text instead of a compelling description, reducing click-through from shares.
defects.remediation_action: Add an og:description meta tag (120-200 chars).

defects.impact: No Open Graph image for social sharing
defects.business_impact: Social shares show no thumbnail, reducing visual appeal and click-through.
defects.remediation_action: Add an og:image meta tag pointing to a 1200x630 image.

defects.business_impact: Social platforms may not know how to render this page as a preview card.
defects.remediation_action: Add an og:type meta tag (e.g. "website" or "article").

defects.business_impact: Twitter/X shares show no image or rich preview.
defects.remediation_action: Add a twitter:card meta tag (e.g. "summary_large_image").

defects.observed: No <meta name="twitter:site"> or twitter:creator tag present
defects.business_impact: Twitter/X attribution is missing; the account that shares this page is not tagged.
defects.remediation_action: Add a twitter:site meta tag with your @handle.
defects.evidence_summary: No <meta name="twitter:site"> or twitter:creator tag present

defects.business_impact: Search engines may discover new pages more slowly.
defects.remediation_action: Add a Sitemap: line pointing at the sitemap URL.

defects.business_impact: Search engines may ignore the sitemap entirely.
defects.remediation_action: Regenerate valid sitemap XML (urlset, escaped URLs).

defects.impact: No phone, contact link or form
defects.observed: no tel: link, contact link, or form element found
defects.business_impact: Visitors cannot easily enquire; direct conversion loss.
defects.remediation_action: Add a visible phone number and enquiry form.
defects.evidence_summary: no tel: link, contact link, or form element found
